load_bearing_assumption: That a meaningful share (≥25%) of Indian D2C brands at 300–2,000 cross-border orders/month have a recurring, named cash outflow (>₹25,000/month to a CA or customs agent) for export docs and e-BRC reconciliation that free aggregator tooling and DGFT's API-based self-certified e-BRC do not already absorb — i.e. that the spend exists and is displaceable.
strongest_failure_reason: No research pass has ever run on this idea; every claim in the reference is [FOUNDER BELIEF], [SURFACE SEARCH] or [RELAYED]. Worse, the founder's own brainstorm record contains the strongest case against it — DGFT self-certified e-BRC and gateway-side reconciliation collapsing the CA process to an API call, aggregators bundling CSB-V docs for free, and the 300–2,000 order/month direct-from-India segment being described as 'vanishingly small' — and the product-mode spec has since pivoted to bulk LCL/FCL-to-FBA pre-clearance for ₹15Cr–₹150Cr brands while explicitly excluding e-BRC/EDPMS reconciliation. This assumption is orphaned: it is neither evidenced nor load-bearing for the product the founder is now building. Nothing here resembles the stub kills zzGA/zzGD, but the outcome is the same — zero evidence after ten days of sessions.
what_would_change_verdict: Raw field notes from at least 8–10 Indian D2C brands verifiably in the 300–2,000 cross-border orders/month band showing a current, itemised monthly spend (CA invoice, customs-agent retainer, named ₹ amount) specifically attributable to export documentation / e-BRC reconciliation, and an explanation from those brands of why Shiprocket X/DHL bundled docs and self-certified e-BRC do not cover it. Alternatively, a founder decision to retire this assumption and re-state the load-bearing one for the FBA pre-clearance wedge (e.g. forwarder lead drop-off caused by compliance fear) and take that to the field.
who_to_talk_to: Finance/ops leads at Indian D2C brands actually shipping 300–2,000 cross-border parcels/month direct from India (Shopify + Shiprocket X / DHL users in beauty, Ayurveda, apparel); the CAs or export consultants those brands currently retain, asked for their fee schedule and what work is actually in scope; Shiprocket X / ClickPost account managers on what compliance they bundle and where brands still escalate; a payment gateway (Razorpay/Cashfree) cross-border team on whether e-BRC reconciliation is now automated for their merchants.
